items.headline: COP31 climate talks end without a deal
items.summary: Delegates called the outcome disappointing after the summit in Antalya, Turkey, failed to agree on fossil fuels.

items.headline: Iran says it hit a US F-16 as Gulf attacks escalate
items.summary: Iran's army said its air defences damaged the jet over the Gulf; Al Jazeera counts about 25 tanker incidents since 14 November.

items.headline: Russian warship hit by suspected drone at Libyan port
items.summary: The corvette Merkury capsized at a naval base in Benghazi. Nobody has claimed responsibility, and Russia has not commented.

items.headline: FTSE 100 expected to open lower after worst week in months
items.summary: Futures were down 0.3% after the index closed Friday at 10,346.34. Compass, Anglo American, Shell and utilities are in focus.

items.headline: AI shares have worst week since March 2020
items.summary: The Nasdaq fell about 5.3% on Friday and about 10% over the week, wiping out its 2026 gains; Nvidia fell about 14%.

items.headline: Drax due to update investors today
items.summary: The power generator is among the companies reporting on Monday, alongside half-year and full-year results from smaller firms.

items.headline: Amazon nears $7.5bn deal for AI start-up Decart
items.summary: The deal would be one of the biggest acquisitions in generative AI.

items.headline: OpenRouter drops three AI providers over prompt leaks
items.summary: It removed three inference providers and 125 endpoints from its zero-data-retention option after research showed prompts being exposed.
items.source: Unite AI via AI News Digest, 22 Nov

items.headline: Hackers used autonomous AI agents to exploit medical software
items.summary: China-linked hackers reportedly used AI agents to exploit a previously unknown flaw in medical software.
